entries.name: Caveman
entries.agent_os_overlap: Agent OS has no output-style instruction; distill tool-output compression exists and saved 0 bytes on 528 replayed results.
entries.rationale: Borrow the three-arm eval (none, 'be concise', skill) and test a terse-reviewer line; the proxy overlaps measured-useless output shrinking and output tokens are a small share of spend.

evidence.development_savings: low: a one-line instruction is cheap to test; the proxy and hooks are not worth porting
evidence.runtime_savings: unproven for us: author measured 3% (caveman) to 35% (ultracave) over 'be concise' on output only; JetBrains A/B 8.5% fewer output tokens; 33.2% input claim is author-run, 54 runs, mostly proxy shrinking
evidence.quality: JetBrains 86-task A/B found no measurable loss (p=0.82); risk of dropping failing-test detail in retry prompts untested here
evidence.reliability: hooks silently fail by design; per-turn reinforcement can fight other injected instructions
evidence.security: installs hooks and a local proxy into agent settings; not run or audited here
evidence.complexity: high for the full package (30+ agents, proxy, engine); trivial for a single instruction line
evidence.maintenance: very active, rapid releases, partly commercial (Auto, Cloud)
evidence.portability: wide agent coverage; our reuse would be an instruction string only

entries.revisit_when: an offline reviewer/planner replay shows output tokens are over 15% of run cost

entries.name: token-savior
entries.agent_os_overlap: Workers use native CLI tools; Agent OS has no code-index tool. Tool-result share of input cost is about 20%.
entries.rationale: The -43% figure is one task on Sonnet 4.5 from a third-party blog and the maintainer's -80% is self-run on active tokens; a 10-task cost A/B is needed first.

evidence.development_savings: unknown: no orchestrator change needed, MCP can be attached per worker
evidence.runtime_savings: unproven: independent -43% is a single prompt on a small repo; maintainer -80% active tokens excludes cheap cached reads
evidence.quality: maintainer reports 97.9% (188/192) on own tsbench with native source tools forbidden; no independent replication found
evidence.reliability: unknown; index staleness across worktrees untested
evidence.security: MCP server plus hooks with persistent memory store; not run or audited here
evidence.complexity: adds a per-worktree index and dependency; large surface (hooks, memory, bench scripts)
evidence.portability: MCP, plus hooks configs for Codex, Gemini, Cursor

entries.revisit_when: the 10-task A/B shows at least 15% lower total cost at equal validator pass rate, or an independent multi-task benchmark appears

entries.name: claude-code-memory-setup
entries.agent_os_overlap: Agent OS already has git-backed durable memory, context compilation and handoffs.
entries.rationale: It duplicates existing memory and handoff features and the author states the 71.5x and 499x savings claims are not reproducible.

evidence.development_savings: none: guide and scripts for a manual Obsidian workflow
evidence.runtime_savings: unproven: README says headline ratios are author-reported; the 71.4x is one 20,000 vs 280 token illustration, not a session measurement
evidence.quality: no correctness evaluation; notes can go stale and source reads are still needed
evidence.reliability: depends on manual vault upkeep and an auto-save hook
evidence.security: hooks and chat imports write into a vault; not run here
evidence.complexity: adds a second memory store alongside git-backed memory
evidence.maintenance: single author, recently updated, benchmark protocol only
evidence.portability: tied to Claude Code CLAUDE.md and Obsidian

entries.revisit_when: a published benchmark with session ledgers shows Graphify-style graph queries beat grep on our recorded worker questions

entries.name: CostAffective
entries.agent_os_overlap: unknown until the mechanism is known; likely overlaps tool-result or manifest reduction already measured as small.
entries.rationale: Two web searches (standard and extended) found no project by this name or the 45.9% figure, so nothing could be evaluated.

evidence.runtime_savings: unproven: 45.9% claim has no traceable source, workload or baseline

entries.revisit_when: someone supplies the repository URL or the post that makes the 45.9% claim
